1538838023848312832.a: Twitter Analytics seems to have been written by students as a learning exercise. Why is it so badly designed? Was their prompt "Heres 60 pages of information and rules to use them. You are not allowed to sort columns and it must forget what you've done if you do something else."

1538838988575981572.a: I posit that this would be desirable behavior if you're trying to hide exactly how bad things are from advertising customers. If you make it hard enough to see how much money is being converted to sales they will never know when or how their money is wasted.

1538987780067442689.a: Talking with manufacturing people... I realize something maybe others do not. I kinda low key knew this but didn't put stock in it until the things I have seen the past few months.

1538987781380362240.a: Project managers saw the pandemic as a once in a lifetime opportunity to shut the entire world down and plan how to reboot it. The companies who heeded this warning seem to be a little laggy for a minute but are spinning up with what will soon seem like alien technology.

1538987782567231488.a: A printed circuit board needed for all electronics devices usually takes hours of labor to manufacture for example. And is limited to basically 1980s tech because that's the way we have always done it. A $1500 fiber laser and a flatbed inkjet printer can do it w/ minutes of labor

1538987783800426498.a: And you are not limited to materials from the 1980s. Anything a fiber laser can ablate. The resolution greatly increases because you are no longer limited by CNC spinny blades or etching with acid at limited resolution and other aspects.
